name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-buildbridge
description: Runs builds and tests of a working copy on another Mac over SSH and brings the results back.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_HOSTS__0__NAME
environmentVariables.description: The word the first host is named by, such as mini; add HOSTS__1 and so on for more. The first host is the one a call that names none gets. Without one the server starts, and a call that needs a host says how to name one.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_HOSTS__0__ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: What ssh is given for the first host: an alias from the SSH configuration, or user@host. Needed once the host is named.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_HOSTS__0__ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The folder everything the server makes on the host lives under.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SDK_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: The .NET SDK provisioning installs under a host's root; empty leaves the host's own dotnet to be used.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_LOW_DISK_GIGABYTES
environmentVariables.description: Free gigabytes on a host below which a run sweeps the caches first.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SYNC
environmentVariables.description: What carries a copy to a host: rsync, a mirror before every run, or mutagen, a session per workspace that keeps it mirrored as the copy changes.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_FEEDS__0__NAME
environmentVariables.description: The name of a NuGet source of this machine mirrored to every host, as both NuGet configurations know it; add FEEDS__1 and so on for more.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_FEEDS__0__PATH
environmentVariables.description: That feed's folder on this machine.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SECRETS__0__NAME
environmentVariables.description: The name of a variable a run gets from this machine; add SECRETS__1 and so on for more. Its value never passes through a tool, a job or a log.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SECRETS__0__KEYCHAIN
environmentVariables.description: The service of the generic password in this machine's keychain that holds the secret's value; use this or SECRETS__0__VALUE in the settings file, never a value in a registration.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SECRETS__0__REPOSITORY
environmentVariables.description: The repository whose runs get the secret; every repository when empty.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_RUN_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a build may run.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SSH_SHARE_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes the connection to a host stays open after its last command, every command going over a shared one; zero or less opens a connection for each.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SESSIONS_AWAKE
environmentVariables.description: The most Mutagen sessions kept awake at once, each holding one of the 42 connections a Mac's sshd has; zero or less sets no limit.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes a workspace may go unused before its Mutagen session is paused until the next delivery; zero or less never pauses one.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_PROBE_KEEP_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a host's answer to a probe is gone by before a run probes it again; zero or less probes before every run.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_SWEEP_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes between two sweeps after a run of one repository on one host; zero or less sweeps after every run.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_CACHES_SWEEP_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: Hours between two sweeps of the whole caches scope carried out by themselves after a run; zero or less leaves that scope to build_clean and to a host short of room.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_WORKSPACE_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days a workspace may go without a build before a sweep removes it.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_OUTPUT_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days Xcode's derived data inside a workspace's copy may go unwritten before a sweep removes it.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_RESULT_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days a test bundle inside a workspace's copy is kept after its last write.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_BUILDBRIDGE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes without an MCP message after which the server stops, unless a job is running; zero or less never stops it.
